summary: BuildPass is a Richmond, VIC construction site-management and AI software company with a US presence in Austin. It raised a seed round in October 2024 to enter the US, sells a Win & Pay finance bolt-on integrated with Xero and QuickBooks, and Richard Zhou has been Finance Manager since March 2025 after BDO's M&A team.

sources.title: Construction tech startup BuildPass erects $7.5 million Seed round
Integrations: Xero, QuickBooks and more | BuildPass AU

claims.text: BuildPass is headquartered in Richmond, Victoria.
Richard Zhou has been Finance Manager at BuildPass since March 2025.
Before BuildPass, Richard was a Senior Manager in M&A at BDO in Australia.
BuildPass announced a seed round led by Carthona Capital in October 2024.
claims.quote: BuildPass has raised $7.5 million in Seed funding, led by Carthona Capital

claims.text: The seed round was reported as funding BuildPass's move on the US market.
claims.quote: BuildPass has raised $7.5 million in a Seed round as it makes a move on the US market.

claims.text: LinkedIn lists 58 BuildPass employees, up 48.8% year on year.
BuildPass integrates with Xero and QuickBooks Online so customers' approved bills reach the accounting file without retyping.
claims.quote: Connect Xero or QuickBooks Online from Win & Pay and your bookkeeper stops retyping invoices.

claims.text: Its Win & Pay bolt-on covers progress claims, invoices, retention, bills, WIP and cash forecast.
claims.quote: Progress claims Invoices Retention Subcontractor progress claims Bills WIP Cash forecast

claims.text: The Enterprise plan supports multiple entities.
claims.quote: Multiple entities, single sign on, custom access and permissions

claims.text: BuildPass is an Australian and North American company with teams in Richmond and Austin, Texas.
claims.quote: We're an Australian and North American company, with teams in Richmond, Victoria and Austin, Texas.

hooks.text: Richard joined after the seed round as the company moved on the US, with teams in Richmond and Austin: a close spanning two markets.
BuildPass sells bill-to-ledger automation to customers, so reducing retyping in his own close is a natural framing.
Fast headcount growth since the raise.

risks.text: BuildPass itself sells finance workflow (Win & Pay, Xero/QuickBooks integrations); possible partner as well as prospect. Interim CFO Mike Grobe has no email on file and was not contacted.

gaps: No finance job ads or posts by Richard found.
Stripe/QuickBooks usage in the account notes could not be confirmed from a primary source.
No podcasts or Facebook pages found.

first.subject: Month-end across Richmond and Austin at BuildPass
first.body:
Hi Richard,

Noticed BuildPass raised its seed round in October 2024 to move on the US market, and that you joined as Finance Manager in March 2025 after BDO's M&A team. With teams in Richmond and Austin, I'd guess your close now spans two markets. I've spent the past year asking finance leaders why AI automation in accounting sticks or quietly fails. That became Vert, which reconciles and cash codes 2x faster with a trail you can trace. How much of your month-end goes on reconciling before the reporting starts?

Best,
Dawoud
Vert | https://vertfinance.tech

followUp.subject: Re: Month-end across Richmond and Austin at BuildPass
followUp.body:
Hi Richard,

Following up on my note last week. BuildPass sends approved bills into Xero or QuickBooks so your customers' bookkeepers stop retyping, so I'd expect you, coming from BDO's M&A team, want the same on your own books. Vert matches bank feeds and payouts to the ledger with a trace you can check. Which part of your close still gets ticked off by hand?

Best,
Dawoud
Vert | https://vertfinance.tech

followUp2.body:
